 GloryBound codes can help you rise through the gladiatorial ranks, starting as a lowly prisoner and working your way up to become a legendary Roman warrior. Head out into the Colosseum on your own or with a squad of four, then fight off tough soldiers, fierce beasts, and mythological creatures on your quest for glory.
The current promos available will provide you with Free Spins and Lucky Spins, which you can then redeem at the Crystal of Fortuna to unlock random Blessings and gain special powers to use in this combative Roblox experience. If you're ready to prove your worth in the arena, then these are the codes for GloryBound and how to redeem them.
 If you'd prefer some general promos that unlock avatar rewards for all experiences, then check out our guide to the latest Roblox promo codes . 
 All GloryBound codes 
 (Image credit: SphereX Studio) The following GloryBound codes can be claimed in-game: 
 NEWMAPSCOMING – 30x Free Spins
 FIRSTUPDATE – 5x Lucky Spins
 THANKYOU – 5x Lucky Spins
 There are currently a handful of GloryBound codes available, offering regular and lucky spins to unlock new Blessings. To use these, enter The Rift from the main lobby area, then approach the big blue Crystal of Fortuna and interact with it. Previous promos have given cash to spend, and chests you can open from your inventory to unlock new gear.
 Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: How to redeem GloryBound codes 
 (Image credit: SphereX Studio) To redeem GloryBound codes, you need to complete the tutorial including your first visit to the arena, which will then unlock new options on the main lobby screen. Tap the Present icon in the top left of the screen to access the Daily Rewards menu, then select the Codes tab before using the Enter a code text box to type a promo. Codes for GloryBound automatically convert to all caps when entered, so you just need to use the right spelling.
 Expired GloryBound codes 
 BERSERKER – 1x Epic Chest
 BOSS – 1x Epic Chest
 UPDATE – 1,000 Cash
 There are already some expired GloryBound codes, as the initial promos have been replaced with more recent ones. This process is likely to continue as the game develops, so make sure you've grabbed any active codes when they're available.
